periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, angled downward and inward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the inferior margin, resulting in a center of mass shifted toward the upper quadrant of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is wide and distinct, roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and highly smooth semicircular curvature at the apex of both pinnae.
